common.homeHeadline: Find the non-rev route most likely to get you there.
common.homeSupport: Nonrevy compares flights, ZED access, load signals and backup routes so you can make a smarter decision before you go.
common.homePreviewMessage: Preview schedules and routes now. Verify airline eligibility when you are ready to unlock ZED, load and member intelligence.
common.exampleLongview: SBP to closest airport to Longview, WA
common.whereNeedGo: Where do you need to go?
common.enterTripRequest: Enter a route or trip request to search.
common.previewLockedMessage: Verify airline eligibility to unlock ZED compatibility, load intelligence, personalized scoring and member tools.
common.verifyIntro: Nonrevy verifies airline eligibility before providing member-only non-rev tools and community intelligence. You can preview public schedules first, then verify when you need ZED-aware planning, load intelligence, saved trips, watchlists, and load requests.
common.airlineSearchPlaceholder: Search airline name, IATA, or ICAO
common.chooseAirline: Choose an airline from the list.
common.companyEmailAvailable: Company-email verification is available for this airline.
common.companyEmailNotMapped: Company-email verification is not mapped for this airline yet. Use manual review.
common.manualReviewCopy: Request manual review. Nonrevy will ask for the least sensitive airline-affiliation proof needed and should delete temporary evidence after review.
common.verificationRetentionCopy: Nonrevy stores verification status, airline, method, dates, and a work-email domain/hash when used. It does not retain government ID images by default, does not publish evidence, and does not treat employment verification as ZED eligibility.
common.verificationAcknowledgment: By requesting access, you confirm you are authorized to use the airline/non-rev benefits you represent and agree not to post confidential airline information. Access may be suspended for misuse or false verification.
common.readyToUse: You are ready to use Nonrevy.
common.verificationRequestFailed: Verification request failed. Please try again.
common.verificationRequestCouldNotSubmit: Verification request could not be submitted.
common.verificationLinkVerified: Your airline employment has been verified.
common.verificationLinkExpired: That verification link expired. Send a new verification email.
common.verificationLinkInvalid: That verification link could not be used. Send a new email or request manual review.
common.verificationEmailSent: We sent a verification email to your work address. You can also use the secure link in that email.
common.verificationCodeCheckFailed: Verification code could not be checked. Please try again.
common.verificationEmailCouldNotResend: Verification email could not be resent.
common.verificationEmailResent: We sent a new verification email to your work address.
common.codeExpiresManualFallback: The code expires at {date}. Request manual review if you cannot access this work email.
common.emailVerificationUnavailable: Email verification is not configured yet. Request manual review instead.
common.verificationStatusLoadFailed: Verification status could not be loaded. You can still submit a request.
common.verificationEmailResendFailed: Verification email could not be resent. Please try again.
common.profileIntro: Keep your employee airline, pass type, home airport, and preferred airports current. Nonrevy uses this to label ZED eligibility as confirmed, partial, unavailable, or unknown.
common.profilePendingVerification: Airline review is pending. Full product access unlocks after approval.
common.profileVerifyBeforeTools: Verify airline affiliation before using search, results, saved trips, watchlist, or load-request tools.
common.verificationZedSeparate: Employment verification is separate from ZED agreement eligibility. ZED access still needs its own profile review.
common.zedAgreementsProfileCopy: Current profile signals only. Missing carriers remain unconfirmed until reviewed.
common.noZedAgreementsCopy: Add agreement details when they are available so search results can show clearer eligibility.
common.profileStatusReady: Profile ready. Update these details whenever your travel access changes.
common.profileStatusSaved: Profile saved. Searches will use these traveler details when available.
common.savedSearchesIntro: Save common routes, flight-number checks, and trip prompts so you can relaunch planning quickly.
common.routeAirportOrFlight: Route, airport pair, or flight number
common.noSavedSearchesCopy: Save a frequent route or trip prompt so it is ready for a quick rerun.
common.savedSearchesStatusReady: Saved searches are ready. Add routes or trip prompts you rerun often.
common.savedSearchesAddPromptFirst: Add a route, flight number, or AI trip prompt before saving.
common.watchlistIntro: Watch flight numbers, routes, destinations, airports, regions, or premium-cabin opportunities so Nonrevy has something useful to monitor even when you are not actively searching.
common.noWatchedTripsCopy: Save a route, flight number, airport, destination, or premium-cabin opportunity. Nonrevy will keep the target ready for alert preferences and future refreshes without pretending it has live load data.
common.savedItineraryAlertsCopy: These preferences apply to saved itinerary options and watched trips.
common.noSavedItineraryComparisons: No saved itinerary comparisons yet. Save a scheduled result first, then return here to tune alerts.
common.watchlistStatusReady: Watchlist ready. Add trips, flights, or routes you want to revisit.
common.watchlistAddTargetFirst: Add a route, flight number, airport, destination, or opportunity before saving a watch.
common.myRequestsIntro: Track requests you sent for real scheduled flights. Refreshes every 25s
common.earlierRequestsCopy: Older beta requests are shown here for continuity.
common.noLoadRequestsCopy: Open a scheduled search result and choose Request load when the flight number, route, and departure time are confirmed.
common.feedbackIntro: Send wrong flight data, missing routes, ZED issues, load-request problems, and confusing screens with useful page context attached.
common.shareCopyFeedback: Your beta account is the main feedback history when available. Export creates a plain-text copy if you need to send it another way.
common.noFeedbackCopy: Use this whenever something blocks trust, looks wrong, or would make the beta easier to use.
common.feedbackAddNote: Add a short note so the beta feedback is useful.
common.feedbackCaptured: Feedback captured. Thanks for helping shape the beta.
common.feedbackSaveFailed: Feedback could not be saved. Try again with a short note.
common.feedbackCopied: Feedback copied. Paste it into email, chat, or an issue when ready.
common.feedbackCopyBlocked: Copy was blocked. Use email export instead.
common.membershipBillingIntro: Private beta access is currently complimentary. Founding-member pricing is planned for the paid beta. Payment details will be requested only when paid memberships launch.
common.billingCanonicalCopy: Billing details live with Membership for the private beta so there is one clear source of truth.
common.currentAccessCopy: Core beta features are available to invited private-beta travelers now. Paid memberships and trip passes are not active yet.
common.coreFoundingCopy: The planned foundation for everyday nonrev flight planning.
common.conciergeFoundingCopy: Core plus broader travel help with a monthly usage allowance.
common.tripPassPricingNote: These are planned founding paid-beta prices, not active charges.
common.aiConciergeCopy: Core flight-search conversation remains part of Core. Broader travel conversation, destination research, personalized planning, and current travel-information help are planned for Concierge with a monthly usage allowance.
common.aiConciergeFallbackCopy: If a premium travel-chat question is unavailable during beta, Nonrevy should preserve the active flight search and keep the trip state intact.
common.billingStatusCopy: No paid-account controls are shown because paid memberships are not live. Future paid beta billing can connect secure checkout, billing management, verified webhooks, and server-side membership entitlement.
common.coreFeaturePlaces: Destination and place resolution for flight search
common.conciergeFeatureCredits: Monthly metered AI credits and fair-use allowance
common.coreTripPassDetail: Planned short-trip access for core flight planning.
common.conciergeTripPassDetail: Planned short-trip access with the AI Concierge allowance.
